submitted_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(total) IS NULL OR SUM(total) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(total) FILTER (WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM public.customer c WHERE c.country = 'France')) / SUM(total) END AS france_resident_share FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01';
validated_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(total) IS NULL OR SUM(total) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM(total) FILTER(WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT c.customer_id FROM public.customer AS c WHERE c.country = 'France')) / SUM(total) END AS france_resident_share FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
